title: IS17_interface2_2

lines.explanation: Declares the interface shape
Declares area() method as public with output type double
Declares volume() method as public with output type double
The class Cube implements the interface Shape. No constructors.
Initializes the variable width as an int object with a value of 2. Default package access.
Initializes the variable length as an int object with a value of 3. Default package access.
Initializes the variable height as an int object with a value of 10. Default package access.
Defines the public method area() with return type double. Finds the area.
will give the return of width * length
Defines the public method volume() with return type double. Finds the volume.
will give the return of width * length * height
the class Circle implements the interface Shape. No constructors.
Initializes the variable radius as an int object with a value of 10. Default package access.
Defines public method area() with return type double. Will get the area.
Uses Math class to get value PI, which is then multiplied by radius * radius to give the area.
Defines public method volume() with return type double. Will get the volume.
returns the value 0.
Defines the public tester class PolymorphismTest
Declares the public, static main method with return type void (with String output)

lines.code: Shape[] s = { new Cube(), new Circle() };
lines.explanation: Creates a new interface list of Shape named s from a new Cube() class and new Circle() class
Starts a for loop for list s. Beginning with value in position 0 (using the integer i) and incrementing the position until i = the length of the list (which is 2 positions, numbered as 0 and 1).

lines.code: System.out.println("The area and volume of " + s[i].getClass() " is " + s[i].area() + " , " + s[i].volume());
lines.explanation:
NOTE: WILL CAUSE AN ERROR, THERE IS NO + before " is "

Ignoring that error...
This will print on a new line the String "The area and volume of " and then retrieve the class name of whatever is in position 0 of the list s and then print " is " and then utilize the area and volume methods of that class.

The final output for position 0 will be : The area and volume of class Cube is 6.0 , 60.0

The for loop will run one more time, and that output for position 1 will be: The area and volume of class Circle is 314.1592653589793 , 0.0
